notes.title: Bank Simulator Modes & Next Release
notes.notes:
[p]🎉 New Game Modes are under planning! | Help Us Decide What Comes Next![/p][p]Hey Bank Sim Gamers, We’re planning to add new game modes to add more depth and challenge to your experience, as some players suggest:
[/p][p]1: Financial Strategy Mode — Master the art of managing your bank’s finances wisely.[/p][p]2: Extreme Banker Mode — gameplay filled with intense action, weapons, and violent scenarios. Robbers will strike with increasing depth and tactics, and you must secure your bank using advanced security systems, strategic planning, and limited resources to save your Bank.
[/p][p]You’ll be able to choose whichever mode fits your play style! But before we start them, we want to hear from YOU.
[/p][p]Please vote to let us know if you like these modes or if you have any thoughts — your feedback means everything to us! 🙌

[/p][p]🔐 Introducing: Integrated Bank Security Protocol!
[/p][p]In the current Game, we will add this feature, and in future, it will be available in both modes.[/p][p]We’re adding a new security system that makes your end-of-day routine more immersive and strategic:
[/p][p]Alarm & Keycard System: At the end of the day, manually arm your bank’s alarm and vault by swapping your keycard, then close the Bank and vault room!
[/p][p]Random Events: At the start of any day after a robbery, you’ll get a notification summarizing what happened overnight. If a robbery took place, you’ll find out if money was stolen from the vault room or teller drawers. Then some cash might be missing, and you’ll have to deal with the damage and losses!
[/p][p]Complete 10 perfect security days and unlock the “Secured & Insured” achievement!
 [/p][p]Your support and feedback keep this project alive — thank you for being part of the journey![/p][p]
Vote below if you want this feature included in both modes in the next release, and stay tuned for more updates![/p]

notes.title: Suggestions and bug fixing update v1

More exciting updates are coming… stay tuned! 🚀

We’re thrilled to share some updates about the development of Bank Simulator! As we work towards the full release, we want to ensure the game delivers a rich and realistic financial experience. To achieve this, we’re making some important changes to elevate the game’s financial depth and gameplay mechanics.

Here’s what you need to know:
1️⃣ Full Game Financial Level: The full version of Bank Simulator will feature a robust financial system, offering a more immersive and realistic banking experience.
2️⃣ Demo vs. Early Access: The demo version will differ significantly from the early access release. We’re enhancing the early access version to support a higher financial level, so expect a more polished and feature-rich experience.
3️⃣ Your Feedback Matters: If you have any financial or banking knowledge, [b]we’d love to hear from you![/b] Join our Discord server and share your thoughts. Your expertise and opinions will help shape the game and make it even better.

👉 Join the Conversation: [url=https://discord.gg/wZ3ACd4h4A]Strong Bow Games[/url]

We’re committed to creating a game that’s not only fun but also true to the world of finance. Your input is invaluable, and we can’t wait to hear your ideas!

Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for being part of the Bank Simulator community. Let’s build the ultimate banking experience together!

Dear gamers,

Are you ready to harness the power of wealth and build your financial empire? We are thrilled to introduce Bank Simulator, a game designed with you in mind. Your experience, enjoyment, and feedback matter to us as we craft a world where your financial strategies shape your success!

[h3]What is Bank Simulator? 💰[/h3]

Bank Simulator is a dynamic business simulation game that lets you take control of the financial world. Build your bank from scratch, make powerful decisions, and experience the excitement, challenges, and rewards of managing a thriving financial empire!

[h3]Welcome to the World of Banking[/h3]
💰Handle essential banking services and ensure customer satisfaction as your branch grows.

[img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3355800/extras/teller_gif.gif?t=1736807572[/img]

[img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3355800/extras/Decore_Gif.gif?t=1736807572[/img]

⚙️Oversee crucial operations, including ATM maintenance, marketing strategies, and investment activities.

[img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3355800/extras/refill_gif.gif?t=1736807572[/img]

[list]

[*] 📈 Investment: Invest wisely to grow the bank's assets.
[/list]

[h3]Features in Bank Simulator Early Access![/h3]

[/list]

[h3]What’s Next for Bank Simulator?[/h3]

Exciting new features are on the horizon! Join us on [url=https://discord.gg/wZ3ACd4h4A]Discord[/url] to share your ideas, discuss strategies, and help shape the future of Bank Simulator. Together, we can make it even better!
